World Cup Matches Feature Records, Upsets, and Asian Team Performance

Recent FIFA World Cup matches have seen significant individual achievements, such as Lionel Messi setting a new scoring record. Several teams have secured or narrowly missed knockout stage berths, including notable performances from New Zealand and Cape Verde, while others like Uruguay and Iran faced early exits. The tournament also highlights disparities in performance, with only two Asian teams reaching the last 32.
